model.name: test:R40.52 owner-identity gate - deployed client transmits x-player-token; server resolves it alone (real-page @390 owner-200 / non-owner-403 fail-closed)
model.description: Bridged to test/visual/r4052-owner-identity-gate.mjs (r4052, gate GREEN, tester commit 118590bf4). CERTIFICATION-SCOPE = FEATURE-PROVEN (NOT endpoint-only): the REAL deployed client transmits x-player-token = the user own RawBinClient.playerToken on an owner action -> 200, with NO manual/harness-minted cookie or seeded sm_session; a non-owner token -> 403; fail-closed on missing/malformed identity. Server resolves x-player-token ALONE (attribution-split holds; NO system literal on the resolution request). This exercises R40.52 AC-real-user-path-acceptance on the deployed bundle - the actual UI action, not a synthetic fetch. Distinct from the tester earlier axis test a5dcc01e2 which was correctly ENDPOINT-scope (harness-minted session). This Test = chain-complete-to-Test for R40.52 (the client-transmits-identity fix).

certificationScope.proven: owner action 200 via real RawBinClient.playerToken (no manual cookie) + non-owner 403 + fail-closed on missing/malformed identity; server resolves x-player-token alone, attribution-split, no system literal.
certificationScope.not: not endpoint-only; a harness-minted session would be ENDPOINT-scope (R40.52 AC-harness-capability-scopes-to-endpoint).
